title: Recording George Lewis and using radio studios
summary: Mares recorded Lewis at WDSU and used WTPS and WSMB, choosing rooms for sound.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Making records: studios, takes and the technology

blocks.x: The radio like WDSU, you mean?
Ah, yes, I recorded George at WDSU, and I got a real nice recording of George, and like I said, done in the studio, and we took time out to tune up.
And different sessions I made, that's about the biggest spots. I made some of them at WTPS, which had a fine studio also.
Got the old Howard Memorial library.
Right, and I also made a few. For instance, I think the Jack Delaney, I made at WSMB. So I kicked around here where I thought the sound was best for that particular band.
